# WriteFile <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Files](BlitzBasic-Files)

</div>


```blitzbasic
WriteFile:Int32 filename:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `filename` | In | String | required | The file to create. |

**Returns:** A file handle, or 0 when the file cannot be created.

## Description

Creates a file for writing. A file that already exists is emptied first.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
file = WriteFile("files_write_example.tmp")
WriteLine file, "first"
WriteLine file, "second"
CloseFile file
file = ReadFile("files_write_example.tmp")
Print ReadLine$(file)
Print ReadLine$(file)
CloseFile file
DeleteFile "files_write_example.tmp"
```

```text
first
second
```
